Provost Garrick Lode: Lode puts two immaculate forms on the bench. A basket maker has left a shaving of wicker between them.
My forms let a stranger trade on the far bank. If the form misses the wicker, I want the stranger to see that too.
Iver Bellcast: Iver sounds the unison bell. A worker in the passage catches it one beat late.
I was the late one once. I want everybody to hear the same warning. Let me hear what the passage does to it.
an agent of the Mirror Court: A courtier sets the best-lit copy on the rail. It draws a small crowd, including the porter who brought the dim one.
They walked past this bench all winter. Give me the bright face for the doorway. I will stand beside the back of it myself.
an agent of the True Measure: A visiting clerk brings a single set of marks. The smallest piece has been mended with thread.
The old measure changed from stall to stall. My father was always the one paying the difference. Keep the local mark beside mine.
Aurelian Ashlock: The delivery office asks for the shortest possible instruction. A square of the sender’s seal has been carefully clipped away.
We have one runner left. If the people waiting downstream need the second line, tell me where that runner should stop.
an agent of the Single Bell: A singer at the public bell has taught the work call to two streets. The second street takes a breath in a different place.
When the fog comes they have to hear each other. Give me one shared beat and I can leave them the rest of the tune.
an agent of the Gilded Seal: A yellow stamp buys the carrier a place on the early boat. The agent opens the pad and waits.
I have stood in that queue. My stamp can save a tide. Tell me what has to travel with it so the next clerk can check.
Vesper Quill: Vesper takes a working slip out of her good coat. The paper has worn through at both folds.
I had to give them an answer before the bell. I can make a second trip. Show me who still needs the first.
an agent of the Scrapers: The visitor has set a clean blade beside the name on the slip. The slip is still whole.
The last time a family name went up, strangers came to their door. The family can speak for itself. Give them time to arrive.
